title: Curt stall turns into opt-out
scenario: Busy small-business owner first tries to brush the rep off, then flatly asks not to be contacted again. Rep complies right away.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Hi, is this Quinn? This is Harriet with Copperleaf Home Loans.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Hi Quinn, I'm following up on a home equity inquiry from last month.

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Oh. Let me think about it. I'm swamped.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Understood. Would a quick call later this week be easier?

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: No. Actually, don't contact me anymore. I'm not interested.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Understood, Quinn. I'll remove your number from our list today.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: You won't hear from us again. Have a good afternoon.
